character: Yvette Delacroix and Ernie Leach in his office
voice: Yvette is affectionate, sensual, and genuinely worried; Ernie retains readable working-class confidence and gambling slang.

entries.text: Interesting. I never noticed that before.
You never noticed what, my love?
You have a tattoo of the Eiffel Tower on the inside of your left thigh.
Are you trying to distract me? I am worried about you, Ernie. You are big and strong, but this Icepick fellow is dangerous.
Yeah, he's dangerous. But I'll pay him his dough. Ernie Leach always pays his debts.
Perhaps you could do more fencing for Big Al. He pays well.
Yeah, Big Al's a good customer, but there's only so much fencing I can do for one guy.
Icepick may make an example of you before you can pay him. He keeps leaving those threatening messages.
Don't worry, baby. Icepick knows he won't get his dough if he kills me. Maybe I can get into a hot poker game at the Harlem Swinger and win enough to pay him off.
No, Ernie. Gambling is what got you into this trouble.
Yeah, maybe you're right. But I've got bigger problems tonight. I saw something I wasn't supposed to see.
You're better off if I don't tell you. Now, what's this on top of your Eiffel Tower tattoo?
I think you know exactly what it is, Ernie. You have seen it before.
And I always enjoy seeing it again, baby.
You American men can be very charming.
